description: Lets a workspace in Odden Cloud serve its public pages (landing pages, forms and portals) from a subdomain of the customer's domain: a TXT record that proves ownership and a CNAME to Odden. For a domain at the top of its zone, where a CNAME is not allowed, see odden.io.custom-domain-apex.
variableDescription: %verifytoken%: the ownership token Odden issued for the domain (the value after odden-verify=).
